4. Dzokera pano.

Sevhisi yeAccessibility: ndiyo nzira chete yaAndroid inobvumidza mapurogiramu kudzvanya nekusunda kwauri. Mareco inoishandisa kugadzira zvidzoro zvinoyangarara, kuisa chifukidzo chisingaonekwi pamusoro peskrini paunenge uchirekodha, uye kudzokorora kusunda kwako. Haigoni kuverenga skrini yako, mapasiwedhi kana mameseji.

Kudzvanya mabhatani: chete paunenge uchirekodha kana uchimhanya, kuti Mareco igone kurekodha Back / Kumba / Mapurogiramu akashandiswa munguva pfupi uye kuziva kumisa kwedambudziko kweVhoriyamu yakwidza + Vhoriyamu yakaderedza. Mashoko akanyorwa haachengetwi zvachose.
Purogiramu iri kumberi: inoshandiswa chete pachengetedzo yesarudzo ye“Mhanyisa chete purogiramu iyi yavhurwa”.
Mareco haina mvumo yeinternet zvachose, saka hapana chinogona kubuda pafoni yako.

Android 13 nemaverisheni mazvo anorambidza mapurogiramu akaiswa nemaoko kushandisa Accessibility kusvika muchibvumidza:
1. Dzvanya “Ruzivo rwe-app”.
2. Dzvanya madoti matatu ari kumusoro kurudyi.
3. Sarudza “Bvumira zvigadziriso zvakadzivirirwa” uye simbisa.
4. Dzokera shure uvhure sevhisi.

Kune nguva refu yekushandisa, gadzirisa kushandiswa kwebhatiri yeMareco kuva “Zvisina kudzivirirwa” (Ruzivo rwe-app → Bhatiri) uye chenjera kuti chaja iri kubatanidzwa. Macro iri kushanda, Mareco inochengeta skrini ichivhenekera.

Bhatani yebhuruu ● / ▶: inotanga kurekodha (“Rekodha macro”) kana kumhanyisa macro yako (“Tanga macro”). Pakurekodha kana kumhanya inoita ■: dzvanya kuti umise. Mushure mekurekodha inobvunza kuti upe zita uchengete.
Bata bhatani yebhuruu nguva yakareba: misa kwechinguva kana uenderere mberi (pakurekodha kana kumhanya), kana misa zvachose (pakamira kwechinguva).
Gear: sarudza “Rekodha macro” kana “Tanga macro”, sarudza macro yekutanga, shandura zvigadziriso zvayo zvekumhanya nezvimwe zvose.
Mipfuti mina: sunda bhari kunzvimbo yoyose yaunoda. X: vhara bhari (rivhurwazve kubva mupurogiramu). Bata bhatani nguva yakareba kuti uone zita rayo.

1. Muna Mareco, dzvanya Tanga kurekodha. Bhari rinoyangarara rinoonekwa.
2. Vhura mutambo wako.
3. Dzvanya bhatani yebhuruu ● paunenge wagadzirira.
4. Ita zviito zvako sezvaunowanzoita.
5. Dzvanya ■ uye upe macro zita.
6. Gear → Tanga macro, gadzirisa zvigadziriso zvekumhanya uye dzvanya ▶.
Misa nguva ipi neipi nekushandisa ■, bhatani yeMisa iri mumutambo, kana Kukwidza vhoriyamu + Kuderedza vhoriyamu pamwe chete.
Live (yakasarudzwa): Mareco inorekodha kudzvanya kwako uye inodzokorora chiito nechiito kuna purogiramu sekunge wasunungura chigumbu, kuitira kuti mutambo upindure pauri kurekodha.
Plan: kudzvanya kunorekodhwa chete; purogiramu haipindure. Shandisa iyi modhi kana Live ichikonzera matambudziko.

• Purogiramu haigoni kuona kudzvanya kunoenda kune imwe purogiramu. Ndosaka kurekodha kuchishandisa chifukidzo chakajeka uye kudzokorora zviito zvako. Kudzvanya kutsva munguva pfupi chaiyo panguva yekudzokororwa kwechiito kungasaonekwi, saka ramba uchidzvanya kwakanyanya nekukurumidza pakurekodha, kana shandisa modhi yePlan.
• Dzimwe skrini dzinorambidza zviito zvakazvimiririra: nzvimbo dzemapasiwedhi, mapurogiramu ebhanga nemapurogiramu anorambidza zvombo zveAccessibility.
• Chete Back, Kumba neMapurogiramu akashandiswa munguva pfupi ndizvo zvingarekodhwa sekudzvanya kwebhatani. Vhoriyamu, kamera neimwe mabhatani hazvigoni kudzokororwa.
• Hapana chinoshanda kana skrini yakavharwa kana yazimwa. Mareco inochengeta skrini ichivhenekera panguva yemacro uye inomisa kana yazimwa.
• Rekodha uye dzokorora mune imwe kuenda kwakanangana (kumusoro kana kurara). Kana saizi yeskrini yakasiyana, Mareco inoshandura nzvimbo uye inokuyeuchidza.
• Android inogona kumisa mapurogiramu ari kumashure kuti ichengetedze bhatiri. Gadzirisa kushandiswa kwebhatiri yeMareco kuva Zvisina kudzivirirwa kune nguva refu.
